item.tib: srid pa'i 'khor lo cha dgu'i rnam bzhag nyer mkho bsdus pa
item.coloph: ces yul mi pho mo rnams la 'khor ba rgyu 'bras kyi ngo sprod pa dang gtsug lag khang gi sgo khang gi mdzes rgyan du mkho ba sogs kyis mtshams sbyar nas rtsa rgyud dang mdzod kyi dgongs pa ltar khod spungs dbra zhig ston pas spel ba'o//
